notes: Odd printed page with no row labels: rows aligned with the label column of the facing even page. Scan is a blocky, low-effective-resolution colour scan; faint (light-inked) figures were read at several blur/zoom settings. Where a digit shape was genuinely ambiguous (3/8, 5/6, 1/7, 2/3, 0/9, 4/1) the choice was made by arithmetic (P=M+F, sub-row sums, a total column vs its members, CIA column total); these are listed below. Continuation of the leaf-304 heads ("...of India—continued", "Foreign to Central India—continued", "...sthani" = Rajasthani spanning head over Marwari/Mewari/Mewati); spanning head "Gujarati" (cols 98-103). Total Gujarati checks fully against the CIA total. Gujarati: row 7 (Rest of Bhopal Agency) persons figure is not visible (blank or completely faded) although males 8 and females 5 are printed; with 13 there the Gujarati column sums 5 more than the CIA total in persons and males (not located). Row 12 (Sailana) Total Gujarati 356/210/146 and Gujarati 355/209/146 chosen from ambiguous shapes (216/140, 200/148) by P=M+F and Total >= member. Marwari row 16 (Barwani) males "?,216", females "?,9??": taken as 3,216 / 3,970 (P=M+F and Total Rajasthani on leaf 304). Marwari column still sums 67 persons short of the CIA total. Mewari row 16 (Barwani) 1,002 / 999 / 3 as read (males 3 digits, females single digit). Mewari column sums 1,013/903/110 short of its printed CIA total 14,748/8,318/6,430: not located. Mewati column does not reconcile (unreadable rows 9, 16). Marwari row 23 (Charkhari) 2/2 (shape 2/3; must equal Total Rajasthani 2/2); row 29 females 6 (shape 6/10; P=M+F). Row 12 (Sailana): Marwari + Mewari + Mewati exceed the Total Rajasthani figure on leaf 304 - see that leaf. Nil cells (".." or dash) omitted; a nil within a triple is null. Table continues across leaves 298-307; this file covers this leaf only.
